corpus_note: the 16M document-diverse scan, one window per document

alt_peak.label: corpus_peak_1b
alt_peak.what: her 1.0B-token scan's rank-0 window activation, which reproduces the shipped corpus_peak of her standard-eval 512 exactly

scale.how: the prior work's own measurement, not a proxy -- no scale to check

card.note: 0.344 is the ENCODER side, which is what this draw indexes; her decoder side reads 0.416 and is listed for context only -- these rows are encoder columns.
card.flag_basis: a firing rate: no denominator either way

act_smoke.why: act_smoke took the max over its 4 rollouts, which IS best-of-4; our bo4 is the disjoint-group mean of the same quantity over 16, so it estimates the same number with less variance. Different 16 vs 64 features, and act_smoke's arm generated 64 tokens.
both are n = 4, so act_smoke's max over them is our bo4 exactly.

DIFFERENT PRODUCT: act_smoke read `examples_4m`, a scan over a quarter of the text, while this run reads the 16M `examples_docmax`. A wider scan can only find a stronger window, so the two are not a difference.
